pk.context: 50 mg oral, steady state, healthy adults

pill.desc: capsule-shaped, film-coated tablet, colour varies by strength

tell: Its menthol-scented oral solution contains 12% alcohol and is contraindicated with disulfiram.

clues.text: Tablet bioavailability for a single dose is about equal to the oral solution, and food causes only a small rise in exposure. It is 98% bound to serum proteins and extensively metabolized before excretion.
A hydrochloride salt whose active moiety has a molecular weight of 306.2. It is slightly soluble in water.
An NDA tablet in strengths from 25 to 200 mg, dosed once daily.
Boxed warning for suicidal thoughts and behaviors in pediatric and young adult patients. Contraindicated with MAOIs, including linezolid, and with pimozide; nausea and diarrhea are most common.
Major depressive disorder, obsessive-compulsive disorder, panic disorder, PTSD, social anxiety disorder and premenstrual dysphoric disorder.
It potentiates serotonergic activity in the central nervous system by inhibiting neuronal reuptake of serotonin.
The generic name begins with S and has ten letters.
